title: ci-local gate 2 grew the repeat leg + four new binaries but the mirrored .github/workflows/ci.yml step still runs only `odin test core` — the drift widened this round (carried since r2 W5)
evidence:
ci.yml:
      - name: Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)
        run: odin test core
--- ci-local.sh:56:
  "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test"
detail: The repo's own doctrine: 'the workflow is the spec; never edit one without the other'. When Actions un-bills, remote CI skips the settings race repeat leg, the app/render/audio/harness suites, and the r3 race regression.
recommended_fix: Mirror the full gate-2 command (5 binaries + repeat loop) into the ci.yml step; rename the gate label in both.

title: The parity suite never runs under any a11y mode or scale — epic-7 requirement 'Full input parity (mouse/touch/controller) holds under every a11y mode' stays construction-argued (carried W14/AC-1 since r1)
evidence:
harness/parity.odin:195:	rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)
harness/parity.odin:1026:	rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)
(grep for ui_scale/reduced_motion/a11y in parity.odin matches only a comment at line 696)
detail: Epic-7 context: 'Full input parity (mouse/touch/controller) holds under every a11y mode'. All 29 scenarios run at Off/×1.00/full-motion; the settings chip/row rects are scale-dependent, so scaled hit-testing is untested.
recommended_fix: Drive the parity matrix once per mode (minimum: ×1.50 + deutan) so the mode/scale-dependent rects are exercised.

title: The scale AC's min-window (1152×648) and ×1.25 step are exercised by no golden, parity, or presence leg — spec AC 'Given scale ×1.50 at 1152×648, then no HUD overlap anywhere'
evidence:
rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance) // every harness path renders at 1280x720
(grep 'a11y_reduced\|a11y_scale' harness/palcheck.odin → no matches; a11y_scale.dem pins 'a11y scale 150' only)
detail: Spec AC: 'Given scale ×1.50 at 1152×648, then no HUD overlap anywhere (top band, QoS, tray, captions, panel)'. The min-window claim has no exercising path; ×1.25 has no golden at all.
recommended_fix: Add a ×1.25 golden demo and a 1152×648 render leg (or un-pin the min-window claim from the AC).

title: Harness capture computes crisis banner_y from RAW constants while the app hud-scales it — the ×1.50 a11y_scale golden under-pins the app's actual banner placement (carried W6 since r2)
detail: The a11y_scale golden's banner sits at the unscaled y; the app draws it lower at ×1.50. The 'no HUD overlap' AC evidence slightly misrepresents the real frame.
recommended_fix: Route the capture's banner_y through rnd.hud(&rc.view, ...) so the golden matches the app frame.

title: Compiled Python bytecode tracked: tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc is committed (carried r3 warning, still in this diff)
evidence:
diff --git a/tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc b/tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
new file mode 100644
--- git ls-files output: tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
detail: Build artifact in the tree; stale-bytecode risk (a future script edit can run the old cache); noise in every diff. Not gitignored.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached the .pyc and add __pycache__/ to .gitignore.

title: modal_blocks_world check claims 'selection intact' in its comment but asserts only panel_open — no sel_pipe assert (carried r3 note)
detail: Parity_Run carries sel_pipe (line 254: sel_pipe = ictx.sel_pipe), so the assert is writable; a suppressed-X leak that cleared selection would pass the named check.
recommended_fix: Assert sel_pipe survived (== 0) on every device alongside panel_open.

title: palcheck routes the 48-vs-40 threshold on pr[0] color-VALUE equality, not pair identity — a future token edit equalizing values silently loosens the gate (carried since r1)
detail: Map-pair status is inferred from the first color's value matching a map token; a collision (e.g. park == canvas after an edit) re-routes a map pair to the signal threshold or vice-versa.
recommended_fix: Key the threshold on token indices carried alongside the pairs.

title: Machado matrices + thresholds duplicated between tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py and harness/palcheck.odin with no cross-check; the script itself runs in no CI gate (carried since r1)
detail: Two hand-synced copies of the science constants; the 'derivation record' can drift from the shipped tables undetected.
recommended_fix: Add a gate leg that runs the script and diffs its emitted modes block against data/palette.json.

title: No presence/content scans for the a11y_reduced + a11y_scale goldens; the a11y demo-verb parse-error legs are untested (carried since r1)
detail: reduced/scale goldens rely on the T2 hash alone; spec AC 'ring/outline widths are static and the banner + glyph + readouts render' has no objective presence leg.
recommended_fix: Extend palcheck with reduced/scale presence scans (e.g. banner text pixels present) and parser negative tests.

title: Demo.a11y_palette u8 duplicates Palette_Mode's implicit ordinals — unpinned numeric coupling across packages (carried since r1)
evidence:
case "deutan": d.a11y_palette = 1
				case "protan": d.a11y_palette = 2
				case "tritan": d.a11y_palette = 3
---
rnd.palette_apply_mode(&rc.palette_base, &rc.palette, rnd.Palette_Mode(demo.a11y_palette))
detail: A Palette_Mode enum reorder silently mismaps every a11y golden demo; nothing pins the numeric agreement.
recommended_fix: Store the enum (or parse by name into Palette_Mode) with a compile-time ordinal assert.

title: Orphaned '// 16. pause' comment now sits above the inserted 7.3 settings scenarios, three blocks before the actual pause scenario (carried since r1)
detail: Numbered-scenario numbering is stale after the r2 insertion; readers land on the wrong scenario.
